purpose: Frame evidence preservation and local CPU latency, not recognition accuracy
eligibility: Existing cached public video bytes, <=180 seconds and <=150 MiB; no downloads or provider calls
split: Group Cavitt A/B and La Jolla A/B; otherwise source ID. Sort groups by SHA256(media-parity-v1:group), first 60% development, next 20% calibration, remainder held_out. Freeze byte hashes before runs.
hardGates: Same temporal plan and complete JPEG SHA256 sequence as baseline on every accepted clip
Same perceptual hashes and dedup survivor timestamps as baseline when hashing succeeds
Any absent or malformed hash retains its frame
No smaller frame budget becomes runtime default without downstream exact-place and multi-place evidence
No paid inference; local timing cannot establish time to correct result
winnerRule: Among exact-parity strategies, retain materially faster local preparation with bounded resources; otherwise retain baseline extraction
parallelRule: Join identical transcript and frames before analysis, settle all started work before cleanup, propagate cancellation; report real local audio preparation separately from simulated ASR network delay
heldOutRule: Choose extraction strategy after development/calibration only, then run frozen held-out once. Serious flaw starts new generation, not tuning against held-out.
